resources.string: Strict passthrough follows the source rate, precision and channels. Your processing preferences remain saved.
Options follow reported device capabilities. Formats are converted in processing mode; a higher setting cannot restore source detail.
Connect and authorize a DAC to apply these parameters. Settings are saved for the next connection.
App attenuation only; the DAC hardware volume is unchanged.
Strict passthrough fixes digital volume at 100%.
Choose Stable if playback breaks up. These profiles change queue depth, not the DAC hardware latency.
Continue silent USB transfers to keep the connection warm. Turn off to reduce paused background work.
Automatic format, full digital volume and balanced buffering. Output mode is kept.
Adjust rate, precision, channels and digital volume. EQ and headphone correction remain available.
